\[

\]

\[
\cos^2 (x + y) = (\cos x \cos y - \sin x \sin y)^2 = \cos^2 x \cos^2 y - 2 \cos x \cos y \sin x \sin y + \sin^2 x \sin^2 y.
\]

\[

\]

\[
\cos^2 x + \cos^2 x \cos^2 y - 2 \cos x \cos y \cos (x + y) - 2 \cos x \cos y \sin x \sin y + \sin^2 x \sin^2 y = \cos^2 x (1 + \cos^2 y) - 2 \cos x \cos y (\cos (x + y) + \sin x \sin y) + \sin^2 x \sin^2 y.

Recall the Pythagorean identity \(\cos^2 (x + y) + \sin^2 (x + y) = 1\), so \(\cos^2 (x + y) = 1 - \sin^2 (x + y)\). Substitute this into the expression:
\[
